verdict.rationale: Shortcut's REST API is explicitly versioned: the docs reference a v3 API and give a v2-to-v3 migration path by changing the URL path prefix. Nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, such as timelines, sunset notices or support windows for older versions. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, sunset/support timelines for prior versions, changelog or version-lifecycle docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: To update, simply change the `/v2/` in your URL paths to `/v3/`.
